title: Partial-swap ternary geometry for conditional κ = 2.093495e-6 > 2^-19
body:
## Partial swaps on the ternary six-block network

Apply icekylinx's #18 partial-swap frames to our #17 ternary construction. This yields the conditional witness

$$\kappa=\frac{2093495}{10^{12}}=2.093495\times10^{-6}>2^{-19},$$

about **11.09% above #18** in exponent saving, not practical runtime. **Subsequently superseded by Zhihao Chen’s #21 (κ = 5.499e-6); this PR remains a checked research record.**

The new frames remove exactly N exceptional source calls, giving `s=Wm-2N+2L`. The h30 producer, physical role allocation, matching, nested basis and all six recursive block multiplicities remain unchanged. The source-relocated auxiliary exit keeps the same projector. The circuit now directly implements interchange; the legacy outer shear-conversion passes are explicitly removed.

The bit saving is 4187/10^9. The unchanged h28 complex construction uses its stronger certified saving 4191487/10^12, beta=1/1000 and C1=3749/2500. All 29 constraints and seven margins are strict; the final absorption gap exceeds 6.16e-13.

### Proof and validation

- Written general common-frame/F3 dirty-scratch, nested-projector, endpoint and lower-triangular conjugation argument in `research/partial-swap-ternary/proof.tex`.
- Independent parallel audit checked the transfer, including the direct-interchange requirement and positive residual convention for descending edges.
- Exact rational tests on 54 projectors, including 30 nonsymmetric cases, verify the conjugation and necessary correction term.
- Complete small framed network checked on all 2,500 independent input symbols, with ordinary and relocated dirty auxiliaries. Negative controls detect missing cleanup, incorrect endpoints and an extra legacy outer shear.
- Both exact moments, precision guard, 29 constraints and seven final margins pass. Four new regression tests pass.
- Complete patch against pinned upstream applies; 144 unique labels and no missing references. The updated manuscript PDF compiled with Tectonic. Active consumers and every displayed slack/margin are regenerated.
- The unchanged physical producer was independently rebuilt in #17, whose complete `make verify` passed 308 tests and 21 inherited patch checks. Its source hashes are revalidated here.
- **Complete:** repository-wide `make verify` exited 0 at `56d4216`: all 312 published tests plus four unpublished follow-up tests passed (316 observed), and all 21 inherited patch checks passed. Physical producer regeneration completed. See `research/partial-swap-ternary/validation.json` for scope and the log digest.

The follow-up documentation correction names all 33 complex rank classes and explains the inverse early-copy split 27+729 already counted by the certificate. The full candidate witness, four tests, manuscript patch and PDF were rechecked; numerical bounds are unchanged.

Finite checks and an independent agent audit are not formal verification or independent expert mathematical review. The general basis, arbitrary-width tape, precision and inherited multiplication interfaces remain mathematical dependencies.

### Attribution and review base

The partial-swap frame and triangular-conjugation identity are icekylinx's #18 contribution at `f2ab41aebad47861caf6316282c1793e5513845e`; pinned unmodified sources, license, NOTICE and hashes are in `references/pr18/`. We claim this compatible ternary composition, not those underlying ideas.

This branch is based on #17 (`c915b4117626a512dd470adbdbd76963108f5cb3`), itself based on #15; the main-branch diff therefore includes those pending dependencies. Review the final composition commit for this addition.

Credit to eumemic (#13/#15 producer, source frames and complex batching), Zhihao Chen (#16 nested basis and earlier five-subset work), icekylinx (#10 tape/batching and #18 partial swaps), Rohan Arun (#14/#17 geometry and composition), Douglas Colkitt, OpenAI and prior contributors. Prepared by Rohan Arun with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and parallel proof/test reviews. No global-optimality or endorsement claim is made.
